caption: A garden hose sprays an arc of water in the evening sun, and the shadow of the arc falls on the soil beside it.

sa.check: A garden hose sprays an arc of water in the evening sun.
The shadow of the arc falls on the soil beside it.
The shadow follows the curve of the stream.
The shadow flickers as the water moves.

pc.expect: The shadow follows the curve of the stream and lands on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or it is a straight line under a curved stream; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the arc's shape and flickers as the water moves.
pc.fail: It is rigid and unflickering while the water plainly moves; or it is a different shape; or it splits into unrelated pieces.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only as the stream moves and would vanish if the tap were closed.
pc.fail: It moves with the stream steady; or it stays after the water stops; or it appears before the water.

pc.expect: The stream arcs and falls, and the shadow lies on the soil.
pc.fail: The stream curves upward; or the shadow stands up off the soil; or the water hangs.

pc.expect: One hose and one stream with its shadow.
pc.fail: A second stream appears; or the shadow becomes solid; or water appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: The hose and the garden stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The hose changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the garden rearranges.
